work.note: 243000 companion and work headers identify Part One (1808) and Part Two (1832); the earlier Fragment (1790) is distinguished, not substituted for publication of the two-part work.

description: Examines Faust’s striving and its consequences, from Gretchen’s tragedy to empire, labor, theatrical form, and contested salvation. Covers Part One, Story: Three Openings and a Scholar at Night; Part One, Story: The Poodle, the Compact, and the Witch; Part One, Story: Gretchen, the Gifts, and the Garden; Part One, Story: Gretchen’s Prison and the Judgment.
